value.rationale: A naturally defined primitive classical invariant sextic acquires precisely seven geometrically ordinary nodes in characteristic 2 versus one triple-tangent singularity in characteristic 7, while smoothness holds at every other prime. This exact arithmetic stratification and local tangent information are useful for studying degeneration, normalization and invariant geometry, without asserting any unproved genus or analytic type.
